newsitem.title: DUBAI: Hyundai to win $80mln Kuwait tanker dea.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai to win $80mln Kuwait tanker dea.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Corp has won an initial approval from the Kuwait Oil Tanker Company (KOTC) to build two oil tankers at about $80 million, a Gulf shipping source said on Monday.
"Hyundai's offer has been approved by KOTC," said a Gulf shipping source. The deal to build two 285,000-tonne tankers at about $80 million is expected to be signed this week, he added.
Samsung Corp and Daewoo Corp have also made bids for the deal, said the source.
KOTC has said it plans to build three 290,000-tonne tankers. It said it had received 15 offers from major shipbuilders.
KOTC has a 33-strong fleet which includes 22 oil product tankers with a total capacity of 1.6 million tonnes and five crude tankers with a combined capacity of 1.4 million tonnes.
KOTC is the shipping arm of the state-owned Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) which oversees the Gulf state's oil industry.
